text:
Maria K: FYI opened a docs PR for Pegasus-XL model card updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :wave:
Sam D: nice — what are the main changes?
Maria K: sequence limits clarified (4k vs 8k variants), embeddings behavior for long context, new benchmark numbers, and compatibility notes for int8 quantized builds.
Raj P: pinging eng-ml — do the int8 profiles described match runtime behavior? I recall a small fallback on KV cache when sequence > 2048.
Raj P: @Ellen H did we document the SDK behavior for the fallback?
Ellen H: I added an example snippet in the PR but keeping it short. Current sdk snippet shows streaming generate + embed call fallback. snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
rc = Client()
# generate with explicit model variant pin
resp = rc.generate(model="pegasus-xl@v2-8k", input="...", stream=True)
````
Sam D: Can we also include a short example for embeddings with long prompt truncation rules? A lot of customers hit odd truncation behavior.
Maria K: good call. Proposed text: "Embeddings: inputs longer than 4096 tokens are truncated from the left; use chunking recommended for semantic search on long docs." Thoughts?
Raj P: technically correct for the 8k variant when chunking disabled. For 4k variant it truncates at 2048. Maybe add a table?
Sam D: tables get long in the card — maybe inline bullet list + micro-example.
Ellen H: I'll add SDK helper snippet for chunking utility, short function only. Also note: quantized CPU fallback (q4_0) not supported for >2k context; runtime will reject with 422.
Maria K: that's important — I added a compatibility note but need exact error string. @qa-bot can you paste the rejection message?
qa-bot: automated test run attached: "error: context_length_exceeded: requested context 4096 exceeds quantized_variant_max_context 2048"
Sam D: perfect. Add that as a quoted example so readers see the exact error.
Maria K: another quick ask — bench numbers. Raj, do we have p50/p95 for 2k and 8k?
Raj P: p50 generate (2k context) = 46ms/token on A100-80GB; p95 ~120ms. For 8k, p50 ~78ms/token. Throughput (greedy) ~680 tokens/s (2k). I'll paste exact table in thread.
Raj P: table snippet:```
Model Variant | Context | p50 (ms/token) | p95 (ms/token) | throughput (tok/s)
pegasus-xl@v2-4k | 2k | 46 | 120 | 680
pegasus-xl@v2-8k | 8k | 78 | 230 | 430
```
Sam D: thanks — add a short note that numbers were measured on A100 and our runtime used batch size 8, continuous batching on.
Maria K: PR checklist: update model card md, add SDK snippet file /docs/snippets/pegasus/chunking.py, update model-catalog entry to include variant tags (v2-4k, v2-8k), add compatibility note for q4_0 + long context.
Ellen H: I'll own the snippets and unit-test for the snippet docs. Putting a small pytest under docs/tests/snippets_test.py to import chunker.
Sam D: do we need a changelog entry? some customers asked about the 4k->8k variant naming.
Maria K: yes, add a short CHANGELOG line under docs/changes/2026-03-22.md: "Pegasus-XL: clarify variant limits and compatibility with quantized CPU builds"
Raj P: one more: runtime will auto-fallback from 8k -> 4k model when memory constrained for Dedicated. Do we want to document that?
Sam D: document as "graceful fallback" with pointer to console config. Keep it brief.
Maria K: merging plan: targeting Friday; will request quick reviews from @Raj P and @Ellen H. If no objections by EOD Thursday I'll merge and follow up with a post in #announcements.
Ellen H: lgtm, will review tonight.
Raj P: lgtm from eng-ml, verify the numbers in the PR match the bench artifact.
Sam D: I'll proofread for wording and shorten the bullet list.
Maria K: thanks all :raised_hands: — leaving TODOs in PR, will ping again when snippets are in.
qa-bot: reminder scheduled: run docs smoke tests on PR merge.
